recognitionRules: Use rounded display lettering with a Memphis-style geometric plate.

quote: Imagine one possible day. Name what you would keep, and what would need to change.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use POSSIBLE COMMONS in rounded lettering with three offset open geometric pieces. Avoid a closed emblem that suggests one agreed future.
invariants: Use rounded display lettering with a Memphis-style geometric plate.
Pair plum and pink fields with selective lime accents.
Give the central future question a large quiet area distinct from logistics.
adaptations: Use fewer geometric pieces on worksheets so responses have space.
Let scenario content vary while participation options remain stable.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
